title: Make wakeup clock composition package-safe
summary:
Make `WakeupServiceProvider` resolvable without `CoreServiceProvider` while preserving
an application-provided PSR-20 clock.
why:
EA01 reproduces three notifications package errors because wakeup resolves an interface
whose only binding currently lives in another provider's composition.

include:
package-internal system clock; conditional default binding; focused wakeup and
notifications witnesses; CHANGELOG and receipt.
exclude:
clock semantics of core; database/server time; retries or lease policy;
requiring notifications to load CoreServiceProvider; new dependencies.

rules:
Bind a wakeup-internal `ClockInterface` implementation only when the
container has no binding. A pre-bound `FrozenClock` must remain identical. Do not consume a
non-public core Support symbol. Use `DateTimeImmutable` in UTC and satisfy PSR-20.
guidance:
Follow §3. Prefer Laravel container `bound()`/conditional registration; do not
overwrite host composition. Add explicit witnesses for standalone resolution and preserved override.

sections.title: Intent
sections.text:

sections.title: Why

whose only binding currently lives in another provider's composition.

sections.title: Implementation Rules
sections.text:
Bind a wakeup-internal `ClockInterface` implementation only when the
container has no binding. A pre-bound `FrozenClock` must remain identical. Do not consume a
